HISTORICAL; superseded by exact MeSH identity below. Re-grounded from CHEBI:78020 'heptacosanoate' (#263). Casamino acids is an acid hydrolysate of casein -- an undefined peptide/amino-acid mixture, not a C27 fatty acid. Mapped to the same FOODON term as the sibling Casein_Peptone record, which is the same class of hydrolysate. CAS-RN 65072-00-6 was already correct and is retained.

Active MeSH C017721 is casamino acids, defined as acid hydrolyzed casein whose nitrogen is converted to amino acids or other compounds of relative chemical simplicity. This exact material term is more specific than FOODON03315719 and avoids unnecessary registry fallback. Ordinary acid hydrolysate remains distinct from enzymatic casein peptone and vitamin-assay grade. Historical source statistics are preserved, not recomputed or merged.
